Sky Sports covers the 2025 Grand Slam (world No. 1 on 16 Nov 2025, youngest PDC world No. 1 at 18 years 299 days) and the 2026 World Championship final (7-1 over Gian van Veen, 3 Jan 2026, £1m, fourth player to defend the title). Title counts disagree: Netflix Tudum says 28 PDC titles including 13 majors, Wikipedia says 30 PDC titles including 14 majors; both are cited in the article. The PDC official profile and BBC Sport could not be fetched (truncated page, blocked domain), so they are not used. The schema only allows birthDate, deathDate, birthPlace, nationality and netWorth as core facts, so title counts are cited in the article text rather than stored as facts.
